sources.title: GitHub - open-free-llm-api/awesome-freellm-apis: 134+ free LLM APIs ...
sources.snippet: Finding a free LLM API shouldn't mean hunting through a dozen GitHub READMEs, signing up for five different platforms, or guessing which models still have a free tier. This repo is a structured, machine-readable directory of every free LLM API — rate limits, context windows, one-click config ...
